title: Topic 9
japanese_text: 仕事を始めた頃、上司に<u>好意</u>を抱いていた私は、いつも上司と一緒にいるAさんに<u>やきもち</u>を焼き、煙たく思って、2人の邪魔ばかりしていた。数年後、上司から当時の私の行動により、Aさんが一番大切な存在だと<u>確信</u>したと打ち明けられ、お礼まで言われた。うれしそうに話す上司を見て、きまり悪かったのは言うまでもない。
english_translation: When I first started working, I had a lot of affection for my boss, and I was jealous of Ms. A, who was always with my boss, and I tried to interfere with the two of them because I felt so awkward. A few years later, my boss confided in me that my behavior at that time made him certain that Ms. A was the most important person in his life, and he even thanked me. Needless to say, when I saw him so happy, I was ashamed of myself.
